title: Lumi hình thái 2 · bị đánh
style: Static locked camera, three-quarter view facing screen-right, matching the reference, the whole body, weapon and shield always inside the frame with a margin, the face visible, the flat solid green background never changes. Clean anime game sprite animation, crisp lines. Hair, cloth, cape and loose pieces always keep moving with natural delay and follow-through, never frozen.

recoil.note: giật lùi Codex vẽ (keys/hit-raw.png, prompt keys/hit-prompt.txt), đặt theo cỡ đầu khung nghỉ; 13/11 thay khóa Qwen chỉ nhắm mắt

segments.name: K2
segments.prompt: A chibi blonde witch girl floating in the air, long golden hair in low braids, violet eyes, a big purple witch hat with a golden crescent moon and star charms, a purple and gold star-patterned cape, a spellbook on her belt, black shorts and black boots, holding a golden staff topped with a dark star orb in her right hand, already recoiling from a hard hit at the first frame, dazed with eyes shut, immediately begins recovering: no second jolt. She opens her eyes, steadies herself with a slight knee flex and returns smoothly to her guard stance of the last frame; hair and cape swing with one diminishing overshoot. She keeps floating in the air on the same spot, feet off the ground, without drifting; no turning or scale change. Arms, shoulders and torso drive the action; hair, cloth and cape follow with natural overlapping motion. Preserve her identity, costume, proportions and the single rigid staff, always drawn whole and clearly visible. No added effects, aura, glow, dust or particles.

game.plan: rest -> recoil (giật tức thì) -> K2 hồi phục -> rest

why_hue_lock: owner 14/11 "Lumi bị thay đổi màu sắc giữa các ảnh": Codex redrew each batch on its own and the robe drifted from the approved violet to red-magenta (Codex review 14/11); the robe hues are brought to the resting frame
sharpen_note: Image 3 is a close-up of the staff head in the resting frame: copy it exactly in every cell where the staff shows. The staff head is a thin gold ring with gold spikes (one long spike on top, small spikes around the ring) on a dark shaft, and the ring is HOLLOW: inside it there is only flat background, with a thin violet rim along its inner edge and one small white four-point star floating in the middle. Never a solid orb: no blue, dark, black, rainbow or glowing sphere filling the ring, no gem inside it. The staff is always held in her hand in every cell, never missing.
